title: #106 – Matt Botvinick: Neuroscience, Psychology, and AI at DeepMind
summary: Matt Botvinick is the Director of Neuroscience Research at DeepMind. He is a brilliant cross-disciplinary mind navigating effortlessly between cognitive psychology, computational neuroscience, and artificial intelligence.
